role: index set for the reduced-product presentation
notes: Nonempty set; distinct from the ideal I.

role: proper ideal of subsets of the index set
notes: Native Ghasemi index/ideal roles retained; I in the earlier direct-product presentation was an index set.

role: dual proper filter of the ideal
notes: A subset is large exactly when its complement belongs to I.

role: factor structure at an index
notes: Every sort nonempty; common finitary many-sorted signature.

role: ordinary two-valued reduced product over an ideal
notes: Native source letter used for the explicitly distinguished classical specialization; not its unrestricted real-valued metric structure.

role: quotient map on product sort elements
notes: Applied coordinatewise to finite tuples.

role: quotient Boolean algebra of index subsets
notes: Symmetric differences in I identify sets; first-order Boolean quantifiers range over classes.

role: Boolean equivalence class of an index subset
notes: Distinct from the element quotient pi_I and from an actual representative subset.

role: factor-formula truth set for representatives
notes: Its class is invariant under equivalent parameter representatives.

role: quotient-Boolean existential partition cell
notes: Same recursive reduction syntax; now a class in P(Omega)/I rather than a subset in the earlier full-product presentation.

role: actual lifted partition of the index set
notes: Lifted sets partition Omega exactly and represent Z_sigma.

role: availability-failure subset of a lifted cell
notes: Each belongs to I by the Boolean availability inequality.

role: finite union of exceptional index subsets
notes: Belongs to I; witness values may be arbitrary there.

role: surjective Boolean-algebra homomorphism
notes: Finite partition lifts use finite choices of preimages.

role: compact Stone space of a Boolean algebra
notes: Burris--Sankappanavar native starred notation; empty for the trivial Boolean algebra.

role: algebra of continuous maps into a discrete base algebra
notes: Pointwise operations; finite range follows from compactness of the Stone domain.

role: basic clopen of a coefficient Boolean element
notes: Source-native clopen consists of ultrafilters containing b.

role: Boolean algebra of clopen subsets of a Boolean space
notes: Oppositely typed star to B^*; retained rather than renamed.

role: clopen algebra of the Cartesian product of Stone spaces
notes: Source IV section5 Exercise1; not the direct product B_1 times B_2.

role: filter of a coefficient Boolean algebra
notes: Source Exercise2 role permits the improper filter; distinct from the necessarily proper dual filter F_I of the reduced-product ideal.

role: closed Stone subspace of ultrafilters extending a coefficient filter
notes: BPIT makes proper filters extendible; empty for the improper filter.

role: coefficient Boolean quotient homomorphism
notes: Sends each labeled partition coefficient to its quotient class.

role: Boolean quotient by filter agreement
notes: b and c agree modulo F when their Boolean biconditional belongs to F.

role: congruence on the bounded algebra power
notes: Source-native equality on the closed subspace F^*; kernel of coefficient transport.

role: clopen equalizer of bounded continuous-power elements
notes: Source Exercise2 uses a subset of B^*; formal presentation gives its corresponding Boolean element.

role: Boolean ideal dual to a coefficient filter
notes: Defines and verifies the quotient Boolean congruence before coefficient transport.

role: Boolean symmetric-difference term
notes: Declared Boolean term used to prove the quotient equivalence and operation congruence; distinct from the factor pattern formulas delta_sigma.
